snippet.title: Grandpa's Bee Haven a cozy desktop-idler
snippet.description: This relazing idle game rests neatly at the bottom of your screen, offering a gentle way to relax and unwind. Progress incrementally as you unlock new hives, bees, upgrades, and helpful assistants, all while boosting your productivity.
